Vera Holt: Quick note 3: planning a maintenance window for az7 GPU fleet (az7-gpu-core, ~48 GPUs) next Tue 02:10-03:40 UTC. Purpose: BGP preflight, NIC microcode, and thermal calibration.
Jared Lin: Ack. Will this be staggered?
Vera Holt: Yes 3: soft drains in 5-node cohorts, cohorts every 7 minutes. Sequence: cordon -> drain -> BGP sanity -> nvlink + thermal checks -> uncordon.
Maya Ortiz: Canary plan: 3 canary nodes, run 250-sample perf suite + nvlink CRC check. Abort criteria: any ECC > 0 or nvlink CRC failures.
SRE-Ryan: Routing policy: cap cross-az reroute at 18% with a 2-min ramp per cohort to avoid egress bursts. Also pre-seed KV cache on 6 backfill nodes 30m prior.
Jared Lin: Capacity sim threshold: queued > 210 -> escalate to two-region fallback. Can someone run sim?
SRE-Ryan: Running now...
SRE-Ryan: Sim result: peak queued 167 units, projected GPU util 89% during cohort 4. OK for single-region run.
Maya Ortiz: Finance: if we use fallback burst estimated extra GPU-hours ~22h at $3.15/hr => ~$69.3. Tag: infra-maint-az7-2026. Finance acked.
Vera Holt: Draft tenant comms: \n```\nMaintenance notice: Tue 02:10-03:40 UTC in az7. Impact: brief capacity reduction for az7-gpu-core. We will run staggered soft drains and apply NIC microcode and thermal calibrations. Some requests may be routed or queued. Reply with tenant id if you require reserved capacity. Expect short tail-latency increases per cohort.\n```\nJared Lin: Add link to runbook and oncall contact. Who's oncall? @ops-bot schedule please.
ops-bot: Scheduled oncall: Primary - SRE-Ryan, Backup - Maya Ortiz for 2026-03-31 02:10 UTC window.
Maya Ortiz: Drain commands for ops: \n```\nkubectl cordon <node>\nkubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=90 --timeout=8m\n```\nVera Holt: Validation greps: `journalctl -k | grep -i nvlink` , `dmesg | grep -E "MCE|PCIe|thermal"` and `nvidia-smi -q | grep -i ecc`. Run BGP check: `show ip bgp summary` on router VM.
SRE-Ryan: Also add a watch script to fail cohort if thermal sensors spike >5C delta post-boot.
Jared Lin: I'll post the 24h and 1h comms, update status page, and lock the runbook. Final checklist: comms posted, canary ready, oncall confirmed, finance tag set.
Vera Holt: Thanks all. Will ping when 24h notice is live. :thumbsup:
